identifiedPrevalence.note: Pupils assessed as having special educational needs arising from trastornos graves de la comunicacion y el lenguaje in 2023-24, 13.9% of the 292,897 with special educational needs; Ministerio de Educacion, Formacion Profesional y Deportes, Alumnado con necesidad especifica de apoyo educativo, nota resumen, 12 May 2025. An assessed administrative count, not an epidemiological estimate, and it counts SEVERE cases only: milder language difficulties sit in a separate category below. 98.6% of them are schooled in ordinary settings, the highest share of any disability type.
identifiedPrevalence.counted: alumnado con necesidades educativas especiales por trastornos graves de la comunicacion y el lenguaje
identifiedPrevalence.denominator: 292,897 pupils assessed as having necesidades educativas especiales

identifiedPrevalence.note: Share of the 838,919 pupils receiving support for needs NOT counted as special educational needs who are supported for trastornos leves y moderados del desarrollo del lenguaje y la comunicacion, 2023-24; same source. Spain splits language and communication across two statistical populations, severe and mild-to-moderate, so neither figure alone is the country's identified total and adding them would mix two different thresholds.
identifiedPrevalence.counted: alumnado supported for trastornos leves y moderados del desarrollo del lenguaje y la comunicacion
identifiedPrevalence.denominator: 838,919 pupils supported for needs other than special educational needs
